purpose: Defines the requirements for the implementation plan document: the information a plan must hold to order, track and trace tasks extracted from design documents, produced by start-plan and consumed by start-implement.
summary: Overview of the implementation plan as an artifact holding tasks, order and progress state
Premise that the plan file format is JSON
FNC-001: task identifier, priority and dependency on other tasks
FNC-002: deterministic selection of the next executable task using progress states (not started, running, implemented, done, failed)
FNC-003: traceability among requirements, designs and tasks, with detection of missing tasks
FNC-004: task granularity executable by a single executor agent without waiting
FNC-005: each task holds paths of documents required for implementation
FNC-006: plan is a temporary working file that may be discarded
FNC-007: plan holds no additive feature identifier; derived via referenced requirements
FNC-008: task groups as the unit of selection, build check and review
tasks: Creating an implementation plan with start-plan
Implementing tasks from a plan with start-implement
Designing or changing the plan JSON schema
Checking traceability between requirements, designs and tasks
Grouping tasks into task groups and reviewing them
title: REQ-024 実装計画書 要件定義書
